title: Administrative Rules on Individuals' Foreign Exchange, PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3
quote: Art. 7: banks and individuals “must not evade limit administration by splitting large amount into small batches or tamper with authenticity administration by using fabricated commercial bills or vouchers.” Art. 13: a non-domestic individual may convert legitimate RMB current-account income and remit it abroad on presenting valid ID and relevant documents.
used_for: Legal basis for the documented-income route; anti-splitting prohibition.

title: Implementation Rules of the Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (Hui Fa [2007] No. 1, as amended)
quote: Art. 2: annual aggregate of USD 50,000 per person applies to individuals' FX sales and to domestic individuals' FX purchases. Art. 13(1): non-domestic individual converting lawful RMB current-account income must present ID plus transaction-amount documents (including tax vouchers). Art. 20: emigration/inheritance transfers follow the separate 2004 measure.
used_for: 50k quota scope, non-domestic conversion paperwork, cash deposit/withdrawal limits.

title: Notice on Regulating Large Cash Withdrawals Abroad with Bank Cards (Hui Fa [2017] No. 29)
quote: Art. 1: aggregate overseas cash withdrawals on a person's domestic bank cards may not exceed the equivalent of RMB 100,000 per calendar year. Art. 4: per card per day capped at the equivalent of RMB 10,000.
used_for: Card/ATM route caps.

title: Regulations of the PRC on Foreign Exchange Administration (State Council Decree No. 532)
quote: Art. 39: evasion of FX control — fine of up to 30% of the amount, or 30% up to the equivalent amount if serious. Art. 42: illegal carriage of FX across the border — warning and fine of up to 20%. Art. 45: private/illegal FX trading — confiscation plus fine up to 30%, or 30% to 100% if serious. Art. 52(2): “domestic individual” includes a foreign national who has resided continuously in China for one year or more.
used_for: Penalty exposure for unlawful routes; residence-based definition of 境内个人.

title: Provisional Rules for Personal Asset Outbound Transfers (PBOC [2004] No. 16) as simplified by SAFE Huifa [2014] No. 2
locator: PBOC [2004] Arts. 2, 6, 8–11; simplified by SAFE Huifa [2014] No. 2 §VI (safe.gov.cn/en/2014/0801/741.html)
quote: PBOC [2004] Arts. 2–11 cover pre-emigration and inherited assets with local SAFE approval and direct bank remittance to the applicant's overseas account. SAFE Huifa [2014] No. 2 §VI cancelled the >RMB 500,000 SAFE head-office filing and cancelled the multi-installment requirement so banks may remit in a lump sum or in batches within the approved limit.
used_for: Emigration and inheritance transfer routes, lump-sum remittance and local SAFE approval.

title: Account and Service Tariff, Personal Customers (effective 1 January 2021)
quote: 5.1.1.1 outward telegraphic transfer: 0.1% of the remittance amount, minimum CNY 100, maximum CNY 500 per transaction, plus cable fee. 5.1.1.2 cable fee: CNY 120 per transaction. 5.1.1.4 cash-to-remittance conversion: 1% of the foreign-currency amount (waived for Premier). 5.3.1 same-name HSBC Global Transfer: free for Premier; reference CNY 50, actual USD 7 per transaction. 3.1.1 foreign cash withdrawal: 0.25%-0.4%, minimum CNY 40.
used_for: Superseded for the wire, cable, cash-notes and Global Transfer items by S21 (effective 31 Oct 2026). Retained verbatim for the audit trail. A commercial tariff, not a regulator's figure, and not a quote for any specific account.

authority: National People's Congress / State Taxation Administration
title: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 revision)
quote: Art. 3: comprehensive income 3%-45% progressive; business income 5%-35%; interest, dividends, property leasing, property transfer and incidental income 20% flat. Art. 15: on transfer of immovable property the tax authority verifies IIT and the registration body checks the tax payment certificate.
used_for: PRC tax rates that can arise before (not because of) a conversion.

title: Enterprise Income Tax Law of the PRC
quote: Art. 4: “The rate of enterprise income tax shall be 25 percent.” Non-resident enterprises without an establishment are taxed at 20% on China-sourced income.
used_for: Company-level tax that precedes a dividend repatriation.

title: United States - People's Republic of China Income Tax Convention (1984, protocols 1986)
quote: Dividends, interest and royalties derived by a resident of the other contracting state are taxed at no more than 10 percent.
used_for: Treaty ceiling on dividend/interest/royalty withholding; FTC relief.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
quote: A U.S. person must file an FBAR if the aggregate value of foreign financial accounts “exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported.”
used_for: US reporting obligation triggered by holding the account, not by converting.

title: Do I need to file Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets?
quote: Unmarried taxpayer living in the US: more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year or more than $75,000 at any time. Married filing jointly living in the US: more than $100,000 / $150,000.
used_for: Second US asset-reporting threshold set.

title: Publication 514, Foreign Tax Credit for Individuals
quote: The foreign tax credit “can only reduce U.S. taxes on foreign source income; it cannot reduce U.S. taxes on U.S. source income,” and is limited by the Form 1116 fraction.
used_for: Why PRC tax already paid usually does not create a second US tax on the same income.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
locator: Federal mandate to report currency exceeding $10,000
quote: Anyone who brings, sends or receives currency or monetary instruments totalling more than $10,000 at one time into or out of the United States must report it on FinCEN Form 105. Failure risks forfeiture and civil or criminal penalties.
used_for: Physical-cash route reporting duty (a report, not a tax).

title: 31 CFR 1010.350 — Reports of foreign financial accounts
quote: Each United States person with a financial interest in, or signature authority over, a foreign bank, securities or other financial account must report that relationship.
used_for: Statutory basis of FBAR, including accounts held in the person's own name.

title: Provisional Measures on Carrying Foreign Currency Cash Across the Border (Hui Fa [2003] No. 102)
quote: Carrying out foreign cash up to the equivalent of USD 5,000 requires no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 requires a bank-issued carrying certificate; in principle no more than the equivalent of USD 10,000 may be carried out except in listed special cases approved by SAFE.
used_for: Cash-carrying route cap.

title: Notice on Further Preventing and Handling Risks Related to Virtual Currency (Yin Fa [2026] No. 42)
quote: Virtual currency has no legal-tender status; exchanging legal tender for virtual currency is an illegal financial activity and is strictly prohibited; financial institutions may not provide account, settlement or transfer services for it. This notice repeals Yin Fa [2021] No. 237.
used_for: Why crypto/USDT off-ramps are not a lawful route out of CNY.

title: 2026 FX administration Q&A, individual FX (10): conversion back of unused RMB
locator: Answer citing Guideline Hui Fa [2020] No. 14, Art. 60
quote: A non-domestic individual may convert unused RMB back to FX on presenting valid ID and the original exchange memo, valid for 24 months from the exchange date; same-day conversions up to USD 500 (or USD 1,000 at a port-side location before departure) may be handled on ID alone.
used_for: Current restatement of the re-conversion rule and the 500/1,000 documentary exemptions.

title: Notice on Further Improving Individual Foreign Exchange Administration (Hui Fa [2015] No. 49)
quote: Individuals may not evade quota or authenticity administration by splitting. Borrowing another person's quota leads to a “watch list”, which lasts the current year plus two years.
used_for: Consequences of quota-splitting. STATUS NOTE: a SAFE mirror page labels this notice “已废止” (repealed) while another SAFE page still publishes it without that label; the anti-splitting rule itself is independently stated in S01 Art. 7 and S04.

title: Catalogue of Currently Effective Major Foreign Exchange Regulations (as at 30 June 2026)
quote: Lists State Council Decree No. 532, PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3, Hui Fa [2007] No. 1, Hui Fa [2003] No. 102, Hui Fa [2020] No. 14, Hui Fa [2014] No. 2, and PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16 as currently effective.
used_for: Confirms the core FX instruments and capital-account simplifications remain in force as at mid-2026.

title: Current-account FAQ: how a non-domestic individual purchases FX
quote: A non-domestic individual purchasing FX for lawful RMB current-account income presents valid ID plus documents proving the transaction amount, including tax vouchers; unused RMB is converted back against the original exchange memo.
used_for: Corroborates the documentary requirement in S02 Art. 13.

title: Tariff of Accounts and Services for Wealth and Personal Banking Business (effective 31 Oct 2026)
quote: 2.2.4.1 Telegraphic Transfer Issuance: Private Banking individuals — Free; PB entity 0.1% min CNY100/max CNY1,000; Premier and Advance — 0.1% of remittance amount, minimum CNY100/equivalent, maximum CNY500/equivalent per transaction, plus cable charge. 2.2.4.2 cable charges: PB individuals Free; PB entity CNY140/equivalent per cable; Premier and Advance CNY120/equivalent per cable. 2.2.4.3 additional cable messages: PB individuals Free; otherwise CNY100/equivalent per page. 2.2.4.4 amendment/cancellation: PB individuals Free; otherwise up to 5 cables CNY200/equivalent, each additional cable CNY40/equivalent, plus overseas bank charge. 2.2.2.1 Foreign Currency Notes Withdrawal over the counter: Free for PB, Premier and Advance; for USD/HKD, withdrawals of at least USD5,000 equivalent need at least three working days' advance notice. 2.2.2.2 Cash Exchange (foreign-currency notes): PB Free; Premier and Advance Free for HSBC Group customers (self-named HSBC card/statement). 2.2.6.1 Global Transfer to self-name HSBC accounts in other countries/territories: Free (PB), Free (Premier); Advance CNY145 per transaction (indicative — actual charge USD20 or equivalent). Service available only in countries/territories offering Global Transfer to Self (tariff remark lists Canada, US, UK, Australia and Hong Kong SAR); not applicable to PB entity customers. 2.2.6.2 Global Transfer to Family (same HSBC Premier Family): Free / Free / Not applicable. 2.2.7 HSBC International Education Payment: Free / Free / Advance CNY50 indicative (actual USD7) — a platform-specific item, not a general same-name remittance fee. Charges exclude other institutions and authorities.
used_for: Current (31 Oct 2026) schedule used for cost modelling; supersedes the affected items in S06. A commercial tariff; excludes other institutions' charges and is not a quote for any specific account.
